text: LLMOps versions prompts, models, retrieval configs and tracks them in a manifest for rollback.
RAG grounds answers in retrieved enterprise docs via vector search, reranking and permission-aware access.
Eval-gate runs golden dataset in CI and blocks deploy on regression. LLM-as-judge reaches 80-90 percent human agreement.
Observability traces prompt version, model pin, tokens, latency, tool calls and quality score per request.
Cost control routes simple tasks to cheap models, caches prefixes, caps tokens per request and alerts on cost per request.
Guardrails filter prompt injection on input and PII toxicity off-policy content on output with schema enforcement.
Deployment uses canary 5 percent then 25 percent then 100 percent with shadow mode and pre-written rollback criteria.
Drift includes data drift, concept drift, prompt drift and provider drift where vendor updates weights silently.
Corona meant beer brand before COVID pandemic now means virus, classic concept drift example.
Tay chatbot 2016 learned toxic language within 16 hours and was shut down within 24 hours, safety lesson.
EU AI Act fines up to 10 million euros or 2 percent global profits for breach of data privacy and AI rules.
Qdrant benchmarked AI search at 10 billion vector scale in September 2026.
